concepts.def: Mixing of European, indigenous and African heritage central to Latin American identity.
Indigenous peoples — over 800 distinct groups across Latin America.
African heritage in Latin America — particularly visible in Brazil, Cuba, Colombia.
Plurinationalism — Bolivia (2009) and Ecuador (2008) declared themselves plurinational states.
Adjectives agree in gender and number: 'culturas indígenas, pueblos diversos'.
Most widely spoken indigenous language in the Americas, with around 8 million speakers.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Multiculturalism in Hispanic Society — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Multiculturalism in Hispanic Society brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Multiculturalism in Hispanic Society.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
